tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish a browser game, world, tool or wonder on Velven's hosting, from one HTML page or a small set of files (3 MB in all). Signed in: a private preview by default, or with prod: true the next live version, live on its Velven page within seconds. Not signed in: an unlisted page, live the same way,

tools.name: my_spaces
tools.description: List the spaces of the signed-in Velven account: slug, title, status, whether Velven hosts it, and its page. Needs sign-in; called without it, the app asks the person to sign in to Velven.

tools.name: versions
tools.description: List a hosted space's versions, newest first: number, status (uploading, preview, publishing, live, refused, unjudged, replaced), size, and whether rollback can pick it. Refused versions carry the reason. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Make an earlier version of a hosted space live again. Only a version that was live before (rollback: true in versions) can be picked; it goes live at once. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Velven's documentation: publishing and hosting, velven.json, the CLI, the SDK (sign-in, leaderboards, saves, achievements, rooms), claiming a page, the agent API and limits. Returns the best matching sections with links.
